Package index

Simulate

The three interfaces to the simulation engine. They differ only in how the process is specified; the output format is the same.

sim_pexp() sim_pexp_cr() sim_pexp_msm()
Simulate event histories from piecewise exponential hazards

Specify

Building blocks of a process specification: a transition, and the variables a hazard formula may depend on.

transition()
Specify one transition of an event-history process
time_scales
Time scales and history features available in a hazard formula

Censor

add_censoring()
Censor simulated event histories
